rules.description: Rule id (`no-empty-catch`, or `plugin/rule`) to a level or a level with options.

abbreviation-in-name.description: Reports a name with two or more capital letters in a row (`XMLParser`), for type, method, parameter, field and local variable names that match the `names` option.

ignored.description: Regular expression matched for the names that are left out (constants, overridden methods): every name by default.

names.description: Regular expression a type, method, parameter, field or local variable name must match; empty: not checked.

accessor-order.description: Reports a property or event whose accessors are in the wrong order: `get` goes before `set` or `init`, and `add` before `remove`.

adjacent-overload-signatures.description: Reports an overload (a signature or function with the same name as an earlier one) with another member between it and the earlier overloads.

alpha-value-notation.description: Reports the alpha value of `rgb()`, `hsl()`, `hwb()`, `lab()`, `lch()`, `oklab()`, `oklch()` or `color()` written as a number (`/ 0.5`), also the fourth argument of the comma form of `rgba()` and `hsla()`, on the function name.

ambiguous-block-association.description: Reports a call without parentheses whose last argument is a call with a braces block (`expect { x }.to change { y }`); also a `do` block that binds to the outer call while a block method is an argument.

ambiguous-booleans.description: Reports a plain `yes`, `no`, `on`, `off`, `True`, `TRUE`, `False` or `FALSE` (in the usual casings), which are booleans to a YAML 1.1 parser and strings to a YAML 1.2 parser.

allowed.description: Spellings that are not reported, for example `["on"]`.

check_keys.description: Also check mapping keys. Turn it off to keep GitHub workflow `on:`.

report_true_false.description: Also report `true` and `false` (unless listed in `allowed`), for code that wants every boolean quoted or spelled out.

ambiguous-function-name.description: Reports a function or method named `l`, `O` or `I`.

ambiguous-variable-name.description: Reports a variable, parameter or `global` name that is `l`, `O` or `I`.

and-or-is-not-if-else.description: Reports a list `a && b || c` of three commands, unless `c` is `echo`, `printf`, `true`, `:`, `return` or `exit`.

any-eq-parameter.description: Reports an `__eq__` or `__ne__` method whose second parameter is annotated `Any`.

apk-no-cache.description: Reports an `apk add` without the `--no-cache` flag.

apk-pin-versions.description: Reports an `apk add` that names a package without a version.

approved-verbs.description: Reports a function named `Verb-Noun` whose verb is not one that `Get-Verb` returns.

apt-get-no-recommends.description: Reports an `apt-get install` that also installs recommended packages.

apt-get-pin-versions.description: Reports an `apt-get install` of a package without a version.

apt-get-yes.description: Reports an `apt-get install` that does not answer apt's prompts.

area-alt.description: Reports an `<area>` that has an `href` and no non-empty `alt`, and an `<area>` that has an `alt` but no `href`.

argument-list-wrapping.description: Reports an argument list of a call that the Kotlin formatter would wrap or join differently: the arguments on one line when they fit, one per line when they do not.

aria-label-misuse.description:
Reports an `aria-label` on an element that cannot be named by it: a generic element (`
`, ``, `

`, ``, ...) with no role, and an `` without `href`.

array-bracket-space.description: Reports an array creation in which the `{` of the initializer follows the `]` right away (`new int[]{1}`).

array-in-string.description: Reports a double-quoted argument that holds `$@` or `${array[@]}` among other text, as in `"files: $@"`.

array-type.description: Reports `Array<T>`, `ReadonlyArray<T>` and `Readonly<T[]>` written as generic types, each level of a nested one (`Array<Array<number>>` is two reports).

array-type-style.description: Reports a variable or parameter that puts the array brackets after the name (`int a[]`).

array-without-index.description: Reports `$BASH_SOURCE`, `$FUNCNAME` and the other bash arrays used without a subscript.

assert-false.description: Reports an `assert` whose test is the literal `False`, with or without a message.

assert-tuple.description: Reports an `assert` whose test is a tuple, usually the condition and the message written inside the parentheses.

assignment-not-seen.description: Reports `var=value cmd "$var"`, where `$var` is used in the arguments of the command that the assignment is a prefix of.

assignment-space.description: Reports a command prefix `var= cmd`, at the start of the command.

async-suffix.description: Reports an `async` method that returns `Task` or `ValueTask` and whose name does not end in `Async`.

at-extend-no-missing-placeholder.description: Reports an `@extend` of anything but a placeholder selector (`%name`); a selector with interpolation is not reported.

at-function-pattern.description: Reports a `@function` whose name does not match the `pattern` option (a regex).

pattern.description: The regex a function name must match.

at-if-no-null.description: Reports an `@if` that compares with `null` (`== null`, `!= null`).

at-mixin-argumentless-call-parentheses.description: Reports an `@include` of a mixin with empty parentheses (`@include foo()`).

at-mixin-pattern.description: Reports a `@mixin` whose name does not match the `pattern` option (a regex).

pattern.description: The regex a mixin name must match.

at-rule-allowed-list.description: Reports an at-rule that is not in the `list` option (a vendor prefix is left out of the name).

list.description: The allowed at-rules, without `@`: names, or `/regex/`.

at-rule-conditional-no-parentheses.description: Reports the condition of an `@if`, `@else if` or `@while` that is written in parentheses (`@if ($a == 1)`).

at-rule-disallowed-list.description: Reports an at-rule that is in the `list` option (a vendor prefix is left out of the name).

list.description: The disallowed at-rules, without `@`: names, or `/regex/`.

at-rule-empty-line-before.description: Reports an at-rule with no empty line before it.

at-rule-no-unknown.description: Reports an at-rule that no CSS specification lists.

at-rule-no-vendor-prefix.description: Reports a vendor-prefixed at-rule that has a standard one (`@-webkit-keyframes`).

attr-case.description: Reports an attribute name that is not in lowercase (`CLASS="a"`).

attr-delimiter.description: Reports white space around the `=` between an attribute name and its value (`class = "a"`).

attr-pattern.description: Reports an attribute name that does not match the option `pattern`, a regex that by default allows letters, digits, `-` and `:` in either case.

pattern.description: The regex the value must match.

attr-quotes.description: Reports an attribute value that is not quoted with `"`: a value with no quotes (`class=a`), and a value in `'` unless it holds a `"` (`class='a'`).

attr-spacing.description: Reports a quoted attribute value that is directly followed by the next attribute, with no white space between them (`class="a"id="b"`).

attribute-allowed-values.description: Reports an attribute whose value is not one of the values HTML allows for it on that element, for attributes with a fixed list such as `type` of `<button>` (`button`, `submit`, `reset`) and `method` of `<form>`.

attribute-boolean-style.description: Reports a boolean attribute that is written with a value (`disabled="disabled"`, `disabled=""`).

attribute-empty-style.description: Reports an attribute whose empty value means the same as no value (`hidden=""`, `crossorigin=""`).

attribute-hyphenation.description: Reports a prop of a component that is written in camelCase (`:cardTitle`).

attributes-order.description: Reports an attribute that is out of the recommended order: `is`, `v-for`, conditions (`v-if`, `v-else-if`, `v-else`, `v-show`), `v-pre` and `v-once`, `id`, `ref`, `key` and slots, `v-model`, other directives, plain and bound attributes, events, and `v-html` and `v-text` last.

avoid-unicode-escape.description: Reports a string or character literal that writes a visible character as a `\uXXXX` escape when the line has no trailing comment.

backslash-separator.description: Reports a pattern with a backslash before a letter, digit, `_` or `-` (`build\out`), which is the pattern `buildout`.

ban-ts-comment.description: Reports a `@ts-ignore` comment, a `@ts-nocheck` comment before the first statement, and a `@ts-expect-error` comment whose description is shorter than three characters (`// @ts-expect-error: the API types are wrong` is fine).

banana-in-box.description: Reports a two-way binding written the wrong way round, `([ngModel])`.

bare-raise-outside-handler.description: Reports a `raise` with no exception in code that no `except` clause of its function contains.

binary-operator-with-identical-operands.description: Reports a comparison, logical or bitwise operator (`== != === <=> =~ > >= < <= | ^ && ||`) whose two sides are the same code (`x == x`).

blank-line-between-declarations.description: Reports a declaration (function, property, class, object, typealias) with a blank line before it that the formatter would add or remove.

blank-line-between-when-conditions.description: Reports a `when` entry with a blank line before it that the formatter would add or remove.

block-comment-after-open.description: Reports a block comment that follows an opening token on its line and ends the line (`if (a) { /* note */`).

after.description: The tokens a block comment must not follow on their line.

block-no-empty.description: Reports a rule or at-rule block with nothing in it, comments included.

boolean-literal-comparison.description: Reports an equality or inequality with a boolean literal on either side (`x == true`, `x !== false`, `true == x`, `x != False`).

literals.description: The texts that are boolean literals

not_operators.description: Equality operators that are not a comparison of value (Python `is`)

break-outside-loop.description: Reports a `break` that no loop of its function or class contains.

cached-method.description: Reports a method decorated with `functools.lru_cache` or `functools.cache`.

cd-without-exit.description: Reports `cd`, `pushd` or `popd` whose failure is not handled, as in `cd dir || exit`.

chain-method-continuation.description: Reports a call chain (`a.b().c()`, with `?.` too) whose line breaks differ from what the formatter writes.

class-naming.description: Reports a class, interface or object whose name starts with a lowercase letter or an underscore.

class-not-found.description: Reports a class, interface or trait name written where a class is used (`new`, a type of a parameter, return value or property, `catch`, `instanceof`, the class of a static call or static property) that no file declares.

class-pattern.description: Reports a class name that does not match the option `pattern`, a regex that by default means kebab-case (`foo-bar`).

pattern.description: The regex the value must match.

class-signature.description: Reports a class header (name, constructor, supertypes) that the formatter would lay out differently.

click-events-have-key-events.description: Reports an element with a click handler (`(click)`, `@click`) and no `keydown`, `keyup` or `keypress` handler.

collapsible-if.description: Reports an `if` whose only statement is another `if`, when neither has an `elif` or `else`.

color-function-alias-notation.description: Reports `rgba()` and `hsla()`, the legacy names of `rgb()` and `hsl()`, on the function name.

color-function-notation.description: Reports `rgb()`, `rgba()`, `hsl()` or `hsla()` with the legacy comma-separated arguments (`rgb(0, 0, 0)`), also when one argument is a call such as `var()`.

color-hex-length.description: Reports a hex color that can be written with three or four digits (`#aabbcc`).

style.description: `short` reports colors that can be shortened, `long` those that are short.

color-no-invalid-hex.description: Reports a hex color that does not have 3, 4, 6 or 8 digits (`#ab`).

commands-show-output.description: Reports a fenced code block in which every non-blank line starts with `$ `, so it shows commands without their output.

comment-empty-line-before.description: Reports a `/* */` comment on a line of its own with no empty line before it.

comment-space.description: Reports a line comment whose text starts right after the marker (`//text`, `#text`).

block.description: Also check block comments: text right after the opening or before the closing delimiter is reported (`/*a*/`). Exempt: an empty comment, and a delimiter repeated (`/**`, `/***/`). The fix inserts the space.

line.description: Check line comments (`// a`). Off, only block comments are checked (with `block`).

comment-syntax.description: Reports a `//` comment where `#` is the convention.

consistent-type-definitions.description: Reports a type alias of an object type (`type T = { a: 1 }`, also `{}` and an index signature type).

consistent-type-imports.description: Reports an import in a TypeScript file whose names are all used only as types (also in `typeof` of a type) and is not written `import type`, a mixed import with such a name (the value names stay in an `import`), and the type form `import("a").B`.

constant-definition-in-block.description: Reports a constant, class or module defined directly in a block.

constant-on-right.description: Reports a comparison with the constant on the left: `null == x` is `x == null`, `1 < x` is `x > 1`.

constructor-summary-standard-text.description: Reports the summary of a constructor that does not start with the standard sentence: "Initializes a new instance of the `<see cref="T"/>` class" (or "struct"), "Initializes static members of the ..." for a static constructor.

container-name-pattern.description: Reports a `@container` name that does not match the `pattern` option (a regex).

pattern.description: The regex a container name must match.

continue-outside-loop.description: Reports a `continue` that no loop of its function or class contains.

copy-from-own-stage.description: Reports a `COPY --from` that names its own stage.

copy-from-unknown-stage.description: Reports a `COPY --from=name` that names no stage defined earlier.

copy-many-needs-directory.description: Reports a `COPY` with several sources whose destination does not end with `/` (`COPY a b /app`).

count-star.description: Reports a `COUNT` of the constant 1 or 0, as in `COUNT(1)`.

curly.description: Reports the body of an `if`, `else`, loop or `when` entry that is one statement without braces (`if (a) b();`, `else c();`, `for (;;) d();`, `while (x) y();`).

style.description: `always`: every body; `chain`: see the rule. The `style` row of the language's `curly_style` option overrides it in the formatter.

custom-media-pattern.description: Reports a `@custom-media` name, without its `--`, that does not match the `pattern` option (a regex).

pattern.description: The regex a custom media name, without its `--`, must match.

custom-property-empty-line-before.description: Reports a custom property declaration with no empty line before it.

custom-property-no-missing-var-function.description: Reports a custom property that the file declares, used in a value without `var()` (`calc(--x * 2)`), on the property name.

custom-property-pattern.description: Reports a custom property whose name, without the `--`, does not match the `pattern` option (a regex), where it is declared, used in `var()` or named by `@property`.

pattern.description: The regex a custom property name, without its `--`, must match.

custom-type-var-return.description: Reports a method whose `self` parameter is annotated with a type variable that the return annotation uses too, as in `def f(self: T) -> T`.

cyclic-needs.description: Reports jobs whose `needs` form a cycle, such as `a` needing `b` and `b` needing `a`.

datetime-utc-alias.description: Reports `datetime.timezone.utc`, also written `timezone.utc` after an import, when the `target_version` has `datetime.UTC` (3.11 and later).

debug-assert-message.description: Reports a `Debug.Assert` call without a message, or with a message that is a constant blank string.

debug-fail-message.description: Reports a `Debug.Fail` call with a constant blank message.

declaration-block-no-duplicate-custom-pr.description: Reports a custom property declared twice in one block (names are case sensitive), on the repeat.

declaration-block-no-duplicate-propertie.description: Reports a property declared twice in one block, on the earlier declaration (on the later one when only the earlier one is `!important`).

ignore_consecutive_different_values.description: Leave a repeat right after the same property with another value alone (`display: -webkit-box; display: flex`).

declaration-block-no-shorthand-property-.description: Reports a shorthand property declared after one of its longhands in the same block (`margin-top: 1px; margin: 0`), on the longhand.

declaration-block-single-line-max-declar.description: Reports a block written on one line that has more declarations than the `max` option.

max.description: The most declarations a single-line block may have.

declaration-empty-line-before.description: Reports a declaration that follows a rule or at-rule and has no empty line before it.

declaration-no-important.description: Reports a declaration that ends in `!important`.

declare-and-assign-separately.description: Reports `export`, `local`, `declare`, `readonly` or `typeset` with a command substitution as the value, as in `local x=$(cmd)`.

declared-name-pattern.description: Reports a name that a command declares when it does not match the pattern of its class, for languages whose files are a flat list of commands (CMake).

ignore_pattern.description: A regex; a name that matches is left out.

markers.description: Rows `WORD:class`: a command with the argument WORD (or the arguments `WORD WORD`, in a row) declares a variable of the class; the last row that fits wins.

names.description: Rows `command:position:class` (`command` may be `command FIRST-ARGUMENT`): the argument at the position (`0`, `-1` for the last, or `1+` for the rest) are names of the class; the class `variable` is told by `markers` and `scopes`.

patterns.description: Rows `class:regex`: the regex a name of the class must match from its start.

reference_end.description: Where a reference ends (`}` in CMake).

reference_start.description: Where a reference to another name starts inside a name (`${` in CMake); the references, up to the matching `reference_end`, are cut out before the name is matched, and a name that is only references is left out.

scopes.description: Rows `block:class`: a variable set inside the block that starts with the command `block` (the innermost listed one) has the class; the row with no block is the class outside them. An empty class is not checked.

default-except-not-last.description: Reports a bare `except:` that is followed by another handler of the same `try`.

default-type-arguments.description: Reports `Generator[X, None, None]` and `AsyncGenerator[X, None]` when the `target_version` gives the last arguments a default (3.13 and later).

delete-apt-lists.description: Reports a `RUN` that updates the apt package lists and does not delete them.

deprecated.description: Reports an element that HTML5 no longer has (`<center>`, `<font>`, `<marquee>`, ...).

deprecated-commands.description: Reports a script that uses a workflow command that GitHub has disabled or deprecated: `::set-output`, `::save-state`, `::set-env` or `::add-path`.

deprecated-import.description: Reports an import of a name from the wrong module for the `target_version`: a name of `typing_extensions` that `typing`, `collections.abc` or `warnings` has in that version, an alias in `typing` of a `collections.abc` class, or `List`, `Dict`, `Set`, `FrozenSet`, `Tuple` or `Type`.

deprecated-index.description: Reports a list item read with the legacy dot syntax, `a.0`.

deprecated-interpolation.description: Reports a string that is one interpolation, `"${var.a}"`, where the expression alone does.

except_in.description: Kinds of the parent (for example `Tuple`) whose strings are left alone. `Tuple`: only a string that is a whole argument is reported and unwrapped, as `terraform fmt` does.

deprecated-typing-alias.description: Reports a subscript of `typing.List`, `Dict`, `Set`, `FrozenSet`, `Tuple` or `Type` when the `target_version` makes the builtin generic (3.9 and later).

descriptive-link-text.description: Reports a link whose text is `click here`, `here`, `link` or `more` (in any case) and nothing else.

destructor-summary-standard-text.description: Reports the summary of a finalizer that does not start with "Finalizes an instance of the `<see cref="T"/>` class." The `<see>` is compared with the name of the type.

detached-semicolon.description: Reports a `;` written after a space, a line break or another `;`, instead of right after its statement.

directive-keyword-space.description: Reports a preprocessor directive that has a space between `#` and its keyword (`# if`).

distinct-group-by.description: Reports `SELECT DISTINCT` in a query that has `GROUP BY`.

dnf-clean.description: Reports a `RUN` that installs with dnf and does not clean the cache.

dnf-yes.description: Reports a `dnf install`, `dnf groupinstall` or `dnf localinstall` (also with `microdnf`) without `-y` or `--assumeyes`.

doc-asterisk.description: Reports a line of a Javadoc comment, after the first, that does not start with an asterisk.

doc-comment-space.description: Reports a documentation line (`///`) that does not start with a single space.

doc-first-word.description: Reports an exported function, method, type, constant or variable whose doc comment does not start with its name.

doc-paragraph.description:
Reports Javadoc paragraphs that do not use `

` in the usual way: a `

` must stand right before the first word of its paragraph (no space after it) and after an empty line, an empty line between paragraphs must be followed by `

`, and the comment must not start with `

`.

doc-param-has-name.description: Reports a `<param>` in a documentation comment that has no `name` attribute, or an empty one.

doc-param-missing.description: Reports a parameter of a documented, non-private method, constructor, delegate, operator or indexer that has no `<param name="...">` in its `///` comment.

doc-partial-required.description: Reports a partial type or method without a documentation comment, or with an empty one.

doc-partial-summary-required.description: Reports a documentation comment of a partial type or method that has no `<summary>` or `<content>` (and no `<inheritdoc />`).

doc-partial-summary-text.description: Reports a partial type or method whose `<summary>` (or `<content>`) has no text.

doc-partial-typeparams.description: Reports a documented partial generic type (one that has a `<summary>`) that has no `<typeparam>` for one of its type parameters, on the parameter.

doc-returns-required.description: Reports a documented method or delegate that does not return `void` and has no `<returns>` (and no `<inheritdoc />`).

doc-summary.description: Reports a Javadoc comment that does not start with a summary: the first sentence must end with a period followed by a blank or the end of the text, and must not start with a fragment that matches the `forbidden_fragments` option.

forbidden_fragments.description: Regular expression a summary must not match at its start; empty: no check.

doc-summary-required.description: Reports a documentation comment without `<summary>` (and without `<inheritdoc />`) on a type, member or field that needs documentation: everything but private members.

doc-summary-text.description: Reports a `<summary>` without text (`<summary></summary>`; `<summary />` is not reported).

doc-tag-indent.description: Reports a line that continues a block tag (`@param x`) and is indented by fewer than `indent` blanks after the asterisk (5 by default).

indent.description: Blanks after the asterisk that a continuation line needs.

doc-text-ends-with-period.description: Reports the last text of an element of a documentation comment that does not end with a period (`.` or `.)`).

doc-text-not-empty.description: Reports a `<remarks>`, `<example>`, `<exception>` or `<permission>` element without text, written `<remarks></remarks>` or `<remarks />`.

doc-typeparam-has-name.description: Reports a `<typeparam>` without a `name` attribute, or with an empty one, in the documentation of a generic class, struct, interface, method or delegate.

doc-typeparam-has-text.description: Reports a `<typeparam>` without text (`<typeparam name="T" />` counts as without text), in the documentation of a generic class, struct, interface, method or delegate.

doc-value-text.description: Reports a property's `<value>` without text (`<value></value>`; `<value />` is not reported).

doctype-html.description: Reports a doctype that is not `<!DOCTYPE html>` (compared without regard to case), such as the HTML 4.01 public identifier.

doctype-style.description: Reports a doctype keyword that is not in uppercase (`<!doctype html>`).

document-end.description: Reports a document without the `...` end marker, or with `present: false` one that has it.

present.description: `true` requires `...` after every document (fixable); `false` forbids it.

document-start.description: Reports a first document that does not start with `---`.

documented-command.description: Reports a command listed in the option `commands` (for example `function` and `macro` in CMake, compared ignoring case) that has no comment on the line right before it, or whose comment has no text (`#` alone).

commands.description: The commands that need a comment (case ignored).

doc_kinds.description: The kinds of comment token that document (none listed: every comment does); a comment of another kind counts as one with no text.

documented-outputs.description: Reports an `output` block with no `description` argument.

documented-variables.description: Reports a `variable` block with no `description` argument.

dollar-variable-empty-line-before.description: Reports a `$variable` declaration with no empty line before it.

dollar-variable-pattern.description: Reports a `$name` declaration whose name, without the `$`, does not match the `pattern` option (a regex).

pattern.description: The regex a variable name, without its `$`, must match.

double-slash-comment-empty-line-before.description: Reports a `//` comment on a line of its own with no empty line before it.

duplicate-column-alias.description: Reports two select elements with the same column name, compared without case and quotes: an alias, or the last part of a plain column reference.

duplicate-ids.description: Reports job ids that differ only in case (job ids are not case sensitive; exact repeats are a different rule, `no-duplicate-keys`), and step ids repeated within a job.

duplicate-stage-name.description: Reports a stage name that an earlier stage already uses, as in `FROM a AS app` followed by `FROM b AS app`.

duplicate-table-alias.description: Reports two tables of one `FROM` clause with the same alias, or the same name when there is no alias.

echo-in-substitution.description: Reports a command substitution that only runs `echo` on words, as in `$(echo $a $b)`.

element-case.description: Reports an element name that is not in lowercase, on the name of a start or end tag (`<DIV>`).

element-name.description: Reports an element whose name is not a valid custom element name: a custom element is lowercase letters, digits, `-`, `.` and `_` and has a `-`.

element-permitted-content.description: Reports an element that its parent does not permit as content (`<li>` outside a list, `<div>` in a `<table>`, a deprecated element in flow content), and one that an ancestor forbids as a descendant (`<a>` in `<a>`, a block element in a `<button>`).

element-permitted-occurrences.description: Reports an element that the parent permits at most once (`<head>`, `<body>`, `<title>`, `<caption>`) when it appears again.

element-permitted-order.description: Reports children that are out of the order the parent requires (`<thead>` and `<tfoot>` before `<tbody>`, `<head>` before `<body>`, `<summary>` first in `<details>`).

element-required-attributes.description: Reports an element that lacks an attribute it must have: `lang` on ``, `src` on ``, `title` on `

element-required-content.description: Reports an element that lacks a child it requires: `<title>` in `<head>`, `<summary>` in `<details>`, `<head>` and `<body>` in `<html>`.

empty-content.description: Reports a link, button or heading with nothing in it and no `aria-label`, `title` or binding to `innerHTML`, `innerText`, `outerHTML` or `textContent`.

empty-heading.description: Reports a heading (`<h1>` to `<h6>`) with no text.

empty-list-equality.description: Reports a comparison with an empty list, `x == []` or `x != []`.

empty-section.description: Reports a `[section]` header with no settings under it.

empty-statement.description: Reports a lone `;` that is the body of an `if` or a loop, such as `while (x);`, on the `;`.

empty-when.description: Reports a `when` with no statements and no comment.

enum-entry-name-case.description: Reports an enum entry whose name is neither PascalCase nor UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (`a` in `enum class E { a, B }`).

enum-first-value-zero.description: Reports an enum whose first value is not 0.

proto2.description: Check proto2 files too, as buf does.

enum-no-allow-alias.description: Reports `option allow_alias = true;` in an enum.

enum-pascal-case.description: Reports an enum name that is not PascalCase.

enum-value-prefix.description: Reports an enum value that does not start with the name of the enum in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and an underscore (`COLOR_RED` in `Color`).

enum-value-upper-snake-case.description: Reports an enum value name that is not UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

enum-zero-value-suffix.description: Reports an enum value numbered 0 whose name does not end in `_UNSPECIFIED`.

eqeqeq.description: Reports `==` and `!=` in the bindings, interpolations and block parameters of an Angular template.

equals-hash-code.description: Reports a class that declares `boolean equals(Object)` and does not declare `hashCode()`.

error-naming.description: A package-level `var` of one name made by `errors.New` or `fmt.Errorf` starts with `err`, or `Err` when exported.

error-strings.description: The text of an error made with `fmt.Errorf`, `errors.New`, `errors.Errorf`, `errors.Wrap` and the like ends in `.`, `:`, `!` or a newline (a capital first letter is not reported).

errorf.description: `errors.New(fmt.Sprintf(...))` is `fmt.Errorf(...)` (the `t.Error(fmt.Sprintf(...))` form on a `*testing.T` needs types and is not read).

eval-array.description: Reports an `eval` whose argument expands an array with `[@]`.

explicit-return-none.description: Reports `return None` in a function whose other returns, if any, return nothing or `None`.

expose-port-range.description: Reports an `EXPOSE` with a port number above 65535.

expression-alias.description: Reports a column of a `SELECT` list that is an expression (a function call, a literal, an operator, a `CASE`) with no alias.

expression-context.description: Reports an expression that reads a context, or calls a special function, that the key it is in does not offer (`env` in the `env` of a job, `runner` in a matrix).

expression-types.description: Reports an expression whose types do not fit: a property that an object does not have, a comparison of values that cannot be compared, a wrong number or type of arguments, or an object where text is expected.

f-string.description: Reports a `"...".format(...)` call on a string literal whose fields all name an argument.

f-string-missing-placeholders.description: Reports an f-string that has no replacement field in any of its parts.

fenced-code-language.description: Reports a fenced code block that has no info string after the opening fence.

field-lower-snake-case.description: Reports a field name that is not lower_snake_case.

field-name-no-underscore.description: Reports a field whose name begins with an underscore.

fields.description: Regular expression the name of a field must match; empty: not checked.

file-lower-snake-case.description: Reports a file whose name (without `.proto`) is not lower_snake_case.

pattern.description: Regular expression the file name without its extension must match; empty: not checked.

file-name-matches-type.description: Reports a file whose name, up to its first dot and ignoring case, is not the name of the first type in the file; a generic type may also be written `Name{T,U}`.

filename.description: Reports a `.kt` file whose name, up to its first dot, is not in PascalCase.

pattern.description: Regular expression the file name up to its first dot must match; empty: not checked.

find-xargs-print0.description: Reports a pipeline from `find` into `xargs` without `-print0` and `-0`.

float-comparison.description: Reports `==`, `!=`, `eql?` or `equal?` with a float on one side (a literal, `to_f`, arithmetic on a float), and a float in a `when`.

float-style.description: Restricts how plain floats are written.

require_numeral_before_decimal.description: Report `.5`, `-.5e3`: a digit must come before the decimal point.

font-family-name-quotes.description: Reports a quoted font family name that is also valid without quotes (`"Arial"`, `"Open Sans"`).

font-family-no-duplicate-names.description: Reports a family that appears twice in one `font-family` list, on the repeat.

font-family-no-missing-generic-family-ke.description: Reports a `font-family` (or `font`) list that has no generic family (`serif`, `sans-serif`, `monospace`, ...).

form-submit.description: Reports a `<form>` that has no submit button inside it and none that names it with `form=` (WCAG H32).

forward-annotation-syntax-error.description: Reports a quoted annotation whose text is not an expression.

from-first.description: Reports an instruction other than `ARG` before the first `FROM`.

function-allowed-list.description: Reports a function that is not in the `list` option.

function-calc-no-unspaced-operator.description: Reports `+` and `-` inside `calc()` that lack whitespace on one or both sides (`calc(1px+2px)`), on the operator.

function-call-in-default.description: Reports a call in the default value of a parameter.

function-case.description: Reports a function name not in the case that the `policy` option sets.

policy.description: The case the words must be in: `consistent` follows the first one written.

function-disallowed-list.description: Reports a function that is in the `list` option.

function-expression-body.description: Reports a function with a block body that is only a `return`, which the formatter would write as an expression body (`fun f(): Int { return 1 }` is `fun f(): Int = 1`).

function-linear-gradient-no-nonstandard-.description: Reports a `linear-gradient()` that starts with a side keyword (`top`, `left bottom`) instead of `to top` or an angle.

function-name-case.description: Reports a function name with capitals (`RGB()`).

function-naming.description: Reports a function whose name does not match the expression set for its kind: camel case; a function with a declared return type may also be a factory named in Pascal case.

composables.description: Regular expression the name of a `@Composable` function must match.

factories.description: Regular expression the name of a function with a declared return type must match.

functions.description: Regular expression the name of any other function must match.

overridden.description: Regular expression the name of an `override` function must match.

function-no-unknown.description: Reports a function in a declaration value that no CSS specification lists.

function-signature.description: Reports a function whose signature (everything up to the body) the formatter would lay out differently: the parameters on one line or one per line, the return type, and where the body starts.

future-feature-not-defined.description: Reports a name imported from `__future__` that the module does not define.

gem-pin-versions.description: Reports a `gem install` (or `gem i`) of a gem without a version: `rails` instead of `rails:7.1.3`.

generic-class.description: Reports a class that has `Generic[...]` among its bases when the `target_version` has type parameters (3.12 and later).

generic-function.description: Reports a function outside a class whose parameters use a module-level `TypeVar`, `ParamSpec` or `TypeVarTuple`, when the `target_version` has type parameters (3.12 and later).

get-attr-with-constant.description: Reports `getattr(x, "name")` with a literal name that is a valid identifier and two arguments.

getter-return.description: Reports a getter written with `get name() {}` (in a class or an object literal) that does not return a value on every path: an empty body, a `return;` without a value, or an `if` without `else` that returns only in one branch.

go-pin-versions.description: Reports a `go install` or `go get` of a package without a version, or at `latest` or `none` (`example.com/tool@latest`).

group-order-style.description: Reports a `GROUP BY` or `ORDER BY` clause that lists both column names or expressions and column positions (`1`, `2`), or that lists them in the other way than the first such clause of the file.

hasattr-call.description: Reports a call of `hasattr` or `getattr` that asks for `"__call__"`.

hash-compare-by-identity.description: Reports a hash looked up with `x.object_id` as the key (`h[x.object_id]`, `key?`, `fetch`).

header-scope.description: Reports a `<th>` with no `scope` (`row`, `col`, `rowgroup` or `colgroup`) in a table that is not a simple one.

heading-increment.description: Reports a heading that is more than one level deeper than the heading before it (an `h4` right after an `h2`).

heading-level.description: Reports a heading that breaks the outline of the document: the first heading is not an `<h1>`, a level is skipped going down (`<h1>` then `<h3>`), or the page has more than one `<h1>` (each one is reported).

heading-style.description: Reports a heading written in another style than the document's: `#` before the text (ATX) or the text over a line of `=` or `-` (setext).

kind.description: The name of the grammar kind of a heading node.

hidden-focusable.description: Reports an element that can take focus (a link, a control, an element with `tabindex` of 0 or more) inside an element with `aria-hidden="true"`.

html-self-closing.description:
Reports an element written in the wrong form for Vue's style: an HTML element, a component, an SVG or MathML element without content should be self-closed (`
`), a void HTML element should not (``).

hue-degree-notation.description: Reports the hue of `hsl()`, `hsla()`, `hwb()`, `lch()` or `oklch()` written as a bare number (`120`), on the function name.

id-pattern.description: Reports an `id` that does not match the option `pattern`, a regex that by default means kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits in words joined by `-`, beginning with a letter.

pattern.description: The regex the value must match.

identifier-case.description: Reports an unquoted identifier not in the case that the `policy` option sets.

policy.description: The case the words must be in: `consistent` follows the first one written.

if-condition.description: Reports an `if:` that is a constant (`if: false`), or one with text around its `${{ }}`, which makes it a non-empty string that is always true (`if: ${{ a }} && ${{ b }}`).

if-expr-with-false-true.description: Reports a conditional expression whose arms are `False` and `True`: `False if a else True`.

if-expr-with-true-false.description: Reports a conditional expression whose arms are `True` and `False`: `True if a else False`.

if-expr-with-twisted-arms.description: Reports a conditional expression of the form `b if not a else a`.

if-tuple.description: Reports an `if` or `elif` whose test is a tuple.

if-with-same-arms.description: Reports two neighbouring branches of an `if`/`elif` chain whose bodies are the same.

illegal-escape-text.description: Reports a string or character literal that writes a backspace, tab, line feed, form feed, carriage return, quote or backslash as an octal or unicode escape (`\u0009`).

img-alt.description: Reports an `` with no `alt` attribute (WCAG H37).

name_counts.description: A non-empty `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` (and `title` on `<object>`) counts as the text alternative.

skip_hidden.description: Leave out an element hidden from assistive technology (`aria-hidden`, `role="presentation"` or `none`).

implicit-alias.description: Reports a table or column alias written without the `AS` keyword.

implicit-concat-in-collection.description: Reports an element of a list, tuple or set that is several string literals one after the other, with no parentheses and no comma.

implicit-nullable-parameter.description: Reports a parameter with a type that does not allow `null` and a `null` default (`int $a = null`).

import-notation.description: Reports an `@import` written in the notation the `url` option does not ask for: by default a string, so `url(...)` is reported; with `url: true`, `url(...)`, so a string is reported.

url.description: Ask for url() instead of a string.

import-ordering.description: Reports an import list that the formatter would reorder or rewrite.

import-used.description: Reports an import of a file none of whose names the file uses.

in-dict-keys.description: Reports a membership test, a `for` loop or a comprehension over `.keys()` with no arguments, as in `k in d.keys()`.

inconsistent-reference.description: Reports a select over one table in which some column references are qualified (`t.a`) and others are not.

increment-decrement.description: `x += 1` and `x -= 1`, where `x++` and `x--` say the same.

indent-error-flow.description: An `else` block after an `if` block that ends in `return`: the code of the `else` can follow the `if`.

ineffective-access-modifier.description: Reports `private` or `protected` before `def self.name`, which does not affect it.

inherit-exception.description: Reports a class that inherits `Exception` directly (`class A < Exception`, `Class.new(Exception)`).

inheritdoc-on-inheriting-member.description: Reports `<inheritdoc />` without `cref` on a type that has no base list, or on a member that neither overrides nor implements anything.

inline-comment.description: Reports a pattern line with a ` #` after the pattern.

inner-join.description: Reports a `JOIN` with no join type, which is an inner join.

input-missing-label.description: Reports an `<input>` (not hidden and not a button), `<select>` or `<textarea>` that no label names: it is not inside a `<label>`, no `<label for>` points at its `id`, and it has no `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

interactive-supports-focus.description: Reports an element with a click or key handler that cannot take focus: no `tabindex`, not a control or link with `href`, and no role that is not a widget (`heading`, `listitem`, `dialog`, ...).

interpolation-check.description: Reports a single-quoted string that holds `#{...}`.

invalid-escape-sequence.description: Reports a backslash in a string that is not raw and does not start an escape sequence (`"\d"`, `"\_"`), also in the pieces of an f-string.

invalid-event.description: Reports an event name, activity type, filter or schedule that the `on` section cannot have.

invalid-expression.description: Reports a `${{ }}` expression that is not closed or is empty, that does not parse (unbalanced brackets, a string that is not closed, a character expressions do not have, such as a double quote), or that names a context or function that does not exist.

invalid-glob.description: Reports a branch, tag or path filter that is not a valid pattern: a bad range or escape, a character that a ref name cannot have, or `.` or `..` in a path.

invalid-job-id.description: Reports a job id that does not start with a letter or `_`, or that has a character other than letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

invalid-permissions.description: Reports a permission scope or value that GitHub does not have.

invalid-print-syntax.description: Reports `print >> file, ...`, the Python 2 form that writes to a file.

invalid-property-value.description: Reports a known EditorConfig or .NET property that has a value it does not accept (`indent_style = tabs`, `dotnet_diagnostic.CA1000.severity = high`).

invalid-runs-on.description: Reports a `runs-on` label that is not one of the known runner labels.

labels.description: Regular expressions; a label is valid when one matches all of it, ignoring case.

invalid-syntax.description: Reports code that Python rejects when it compiles the file although the grammar allows it, such as a duplicate parameter, `nonlocal` at module level or `await` in a function that is not async.

is-literal.description: Reports an identity test (`is` or `is not`) with a string, bytes or number literal, a list, set, dict or comprehension, or a tuple of constants.

iterate-file-output.description: Reports a `for` loop over the output of `cat`, `sort`, `sed`, `head` or `tail`.

iterate-find-output.description: Reports a `for` loop over the output of `find`.

iterate-ls-output.description: Reports a `for` loop over the output of `ls`.

json-cmd-entrypoint.description: Reports a `CMD`, `ENTRYPOINT` or `HEALTHCHECK CMD` in shell form.

key-name-casing.description: Reports a key that does not follow one of the allowed naming conventions of the option `allowed` (default `camelCase`; also `PascalCase`, `snake_case`, `kebab-case`, `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`).

allowed.description: Accepted conventions: `camelCase`, `PascalCase`, `snake_case`, `kebab-case`, `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`. A key is fine when it matches one.

ignored_keys.description: Regular expressions; matching keys stay where they are and are not compared.

keyframe-block-no-duplicate-selectors.description: Reports a selector that is used twice in one `@keyframes` rule (`from` and `FROM` count as the same, names are compared in lowercase).

keyframe-declaration-no-important.description: Reports `!important` in a declaration of a `@keyframes` rule.

keyframe-selector-notation.description: Reports `from` and `to` in a `@keyframes` that also uses percentages.

keyframes-name-pattern.description: Reports a `@keyframes` name that does not match the `pattern` option (a regex).

pattern.description: The regex a keyframes name must match.

keyword-case.description: Reports a keyword not in the case that the `policy` option sets.

policy.description: The case the words must be in: `consistent` follows the first one written.

keyword-identifier.description: Reports an unquoted name written like a keyword of the dialect, such as a column called `year` or `name`.

label-has-control.description: Reports a `<label>` that names no control: it has no `for` attribute (a bound `[for]` counts) and holds no labelable element (`<input>` that is not hidden, `<select>`, `<textarea>`, `<button>`, `<meter>`, `<output>`, `<progress>`).

lambda-assignment.description: Reports a lambda assigned to a single name.

last-user-not-root.description: Reports a stage whose last `USER` is root, on that `USER`.

late-future-import.description: Reports a `from __future__` import that comes after other statements.

layer-name-pattern.description: Reports a `@layer` name that does not match the `pattern` option (a regex).

pattern.description: The regex a layer name must match.

length-zero-no-unit.description: Reports a zero length written with a unit (`0px`).

link-text.description: Reports a link (`<a href>`) with no text, no image with an `alt` and no `aria-label` (WCAG H30).

literal-case.description: Reports `NULL`, `TRUE` or `FALSE` not in the case that the `policy` option sets.

policy.description: The case the words must be in: `consistent` follows the first one written.

literal-in-interpolation.description: Reports a number, symbol, `true`, `false`, `nil` or string literal that is the whole content of a `#{...}`.

load-no-partial-leading-underscore.description: Reports a `@use`, `@forward` or `@import` of a partial with a leading underscore (`@use 'a/_b'`).

map-dup-name.description: Reports a `<map>` whose `name` an earlier `<map>` already has.

max-body-length.description: Reports a rule whose recipe has more lines than the `max` option.

max.description: The most lines a recipe may have.

max-line-length.description: Reports a line longer than `max` characters (default 120).

allow_non_breakable_inline_mappings.description: With `allow_non_breakable_words`, also do not report a `key: value` line whose value has no space. Only in languages that have such lines (YAML).

allow_non_breakable_words.description: Do not report a line that has no space after its indentation (and after a leading `#` run or `- `), such as a long URL.

max-nesting-depth.description: Reports a rule or at-rule nested inside more rules or at-rules than the `max` option.

media-feature-name-allowed-list.description: Reports a media feature that is not in the `list` option.

list.description: The allowed media features: names, or `/regex/`.

media-feature-name-disallowed-list.description: Reports a media feature that is in the `list` option.

list.description: The disallowed media features: names, or `/regex/`.

media-feature-name-no-unknown.description: Reports a media feature name in `@media` that is not a CSS one; vendor-prefixed names are not reported.

media-type-no-deprecated.description: Reports a deprecated media type (`tv`, `handheld`, `projection`, ...) in `@media`.

member-order.description: Reports a member that is out of order compared with the member before it, in the order of the `element_order` option: the kind (fields, constructors, finalizers, delegates, events, enums, interfaces, properties, indexers, operators, methods, structs, classes; in a namespace or file: namespaces, delegates, enums, interfaces, structs, classes), the access (public, internal, protected internal, protected, private protected, private), constants before other fields, static before instance members, readonly fields before the others.

element_order.description: The traits that decide the order, most important first. A trait that is left out is not checked.

merge-consecutive-run.description: Reports a `RUN` that could be merged into the `RUN` before it.

message-pascal-case.description: Reports a message name that is not PascalCase.

min-phony.description: Reports a target of the `required` option (default `all`, `clean` and `test`) that is not declared `.PHONY`, on the last `.PHONY` line, or on the last rule when there is none.

required.description: The targets every Makefile must declare `.PHONY`.

missing-doc-comment.description: Reports a type, member, field or enum item that needs documentation and has no `///` comment before it: public, protected or internal ones, in types that are too.

missing-doctype.description: Reports a document that has no doctype, on its start.

missing-mandatory-parameter.description: Reports a call of a cmdlet that gives none of the parameters that every parameter set requires, by name or by position.

missing-package-comment.description: Reports a package that has no comment right above the `package` clause in any file of its directory.

missing-permissions.description: Reports a job with no `permissions`, in a workflow with no top-level `permissions`.

missing-return.description: Reports a function or method whose native return type or `@return` tag is not `void` or `never` and whose end can be reached without a `return` or `throw`, on the last statement that reaches the end.

missing-super.description: Reports `initialize` of a class with a parent other than `Object`, and the callbacks `inherited` and `method_added`, that do not call `super`.

missing-switch-default.description: Reports a `switch` statement that has no `default` label.

mixed-regexp-capture-types.description: Reports a regexp literal that has both named groups (`(?<name>...)`) and plain groups (`(...)`).

modifier-order.description: Reports the modifiers of a declaration (`public`, `static`, `final`, `override`, ...) that are not in the order the style of the language wants: for Java the order of the Java Language Specification (`public protected private abstract default static sealed non-sealed final transient volatile synchronized native strictfp`), for Kotlin the order of the Kotlin coding conventions.

report.description: Where a finding is reported: on the keyword that is out of place, or on the first token of the modifier list.

module-import-not-at-top-of-file.description: Reports an import at module level after code.

mouse-events-have-key-events.description: Reports a `mouseover` handler with no `focus` handler and a `mouseout` handler with no `blur` handler on the same element.

multiline-expression-wrapping.description: Reports an expression that spans lines and starts after code on its line: the value of a property or a function body after `=`, or an argument.

multiline-if-else.description: Reports an `if` whose line breaks the formatter would change.

multiple-imports-on-one-line.description: Reports an `import` that names several modules, as in `import os, sys`.

multiple-labeled-controls.description: Reports a `<label>` with no `for` that holds more than one control.

multiple-starred-expressions.description: Reports an assignment target with two starred names, such as `a, *b, *c = x`.

multiple-starts-ends-with.description: Reports `a.startswith(x) or a.startswith(y)` and the same with `endswith`.

multiple-statements-on-one-line-colon.description: Reports a compound statement whose body starts on the line of its colon, as in `if x: y()`.

multiple-statements-on-one-line-semicolo.description: Reports statements joined by `;` on one line.

mutable-argument-default.description: Reports a parameter whose default is a list, dict or set: a literal, a comprehension, or a call of `list()`, `dict()`, `set()`, `collections.deque()` and the like.

mutable-class-default.description: Reports a class attribute assigned a list, dict, set or comprehension, or a call that builds one, with no `ClassVar` or `Final` annotation.

name-pattern.description: Reports the `name` of a form control that does not match the option `pattern`, a regex that by default means camelCase, with a trailing `[]` allowed.

pattern.description: The regex the value must match.

named-grid-areas-no-invalid.description: Reports a `grid-template-areas` whose rows differ in length, are empty, or hold an area that is not a rectangle.

naming-convention.description: Reports a name that does not follow the style set for what it names: operations, fragments, variables, fields, arguments, types, enum values and directives.

arguments.description: Style of argument names in definitions.

fields.description: Style of field and input field names in definitions.

needless-bool.description: Reports an `if` that returns `True` or `False` and is followed, directly or in an `else`, by a return of the opposite boolean.

needless-quotes.description: Reports a quoted name that is a plain word, not reserved, and already in the case the dialect folds unquoted names to (upper case for ansi, lower case for postgres), so the quotes change nothing.

negate-equal-op.description: Reports `not` applied to a comparison with `==`, as in `not a == b`.

negate-not-equal-op.description: Reports `not` applied to a comparison with `!=`, as in `not a != b`.

negation-of-excluded-parent.description: Reports a `!` pattern for a path whose parent directory is excluded by an earlier pattern (`!a/b` after `a/`).

nested-with.description: Reports a `with` whose only statement is another `with`, when both are sync or both are async.

newline-wrapping.description: Reports a bracket, comma or arrow where the formatter would break the line, or add a trailing comma.

no-abstract-role.description: Reports a `role` that is one of the abstract roles of the ARIA taxonomy (`widget`, `landmark`, `command`, ...).

no-alt-text.description: Reports an image whose alternate text is empty (`![](url)`).

no-ambiguous-ampersand.description: Reports an `&` in text that starts no character reference (`a & b`), and a raw `<` in text where it is not a syntax error, such as the Hugo shortcode `{{<`.

no-anonymous-operations.description: Reports an operation without a name (`{ a }`, `query { a }`).

no-apt.description: Reports a `RUN` that calls `apt`; use `apt-get` or `apt-cache` instead.

no-assignment-in-condition.description: Reports an assignment used as the condition of an `if`, a ternary or a loop (`if (a = b)`, `while (x = next())`) when it is not wrapped in parentheses of its own (`if ((a = b))` is accepted).

no-assignment-in-logical-condition.description: Reports a condition that is a logical operation (`&&`, `||`) with an assignment as the right operand not in parentheses (`if a && b = c`).

no-async-promise-executor.description: Reports `new Promise(async ...)`: an `async` function (or arrow function) as the executor, with or without a second argument.

no-autofocus.description: Reports an element with an `autofocus` attribute (or a bound `[autofocus]` on an HTML element; on a component it is one of its inputs).

no-automatic-variable-assignment.description: Reports an assignment to an automatic variable, a parameter or a `foreach` variable that has the name of one (`$Error`, `$Event`, `$input`, `$PSItem`, `$_`, `$PWD`, `$Host`, `$this`, `$true` and so on).

no-backticks.description: Reports a command substitution written with backticks.

no-bare-urls.description: Reports a URL (`http://` or `https://`) written in a paragraph that is neither a link nor an autolink, on the URL.

no-bind-value-on-checkable-inputs.description: Reports `bind:value` on a checkbox or a radio button.

no-broad-catch.description: Reports a `catch`, `except` or `rescue` clause that catches everything (a clause with no type, when the `bare` option is set) or one of the broad `types`, when it does not raise the error again and has no call that matches `handled`.

bare.description: A clause with no type is broad

handled.description: A call that handles the error (logs its traceback)

no-case-declarations.description: Reports a `let`, `const`, `using`, function or class declared directly in a `case` or `default` clause.

no-child-content.description: Reports an element that has `v-html` or `v-text` and also content between its tags.

no-class-assign.description: Reports an assignment to a class that is declared by name (`class K {} K = 1;`).

no-cmdlet-aliases.description: Reports a command written with one of the default aliases of Windows PowerShell and PowerShell 7 (`gci`, `ls`, `%`, `?`, `iex` and so on).

no-comment-before-block.description: Reports a comment between the head of an `if`, `else`, `while`, `do`, `for`, `foreach`, `lock`, `try`, `catch`, `finally`, `switch`, `checked` or `unchecked` and its `{`.

no-compare-neg-zero.description: Reports a comparison with `-0` on either side of `==`, `!=`, `===`, `!==`, `<`, `<=`, `>` or `>=`.

no-conditional-comment.description: Reports an Internet Explorer conditional comment (`<!--[if IE]>`).

no-const-assign.description: Reports a write to a `const` variable after its declaration: an assignment, `++` or `--`, or a destructuring target (`[c] = [1]`).

no-constant-comparison.description: Reports an equality or a comparison whose two sides are both literals (`1 === 2`, `"a" < "b"`).

no-constant-condition.description: Reports the condition of an `if`, a ternary or a loop that is a literal (`if (true)`, `if (0)`, `x = true ? 1 : 2`, `while (false)`).

no-control-regex.description: Reports a control character (below U+0020) in the constant string given to `new Regex(...)` and the static methods of `Regex`, written raw or as an escape.

no-copy-whole-stage.description: Reports a `COPY --from=stage / /`, which copies the whole file system of a stage to `/`.

no-debugger.description: Reports a statement or a call that stops the program in a debugger: a `debugger;` statement, a call of one of the `calls` of the language (Python `breakpoint()`, `pdb.set_trace()`), or an import matching the option `imports`.

imports.description: An import of a debugger module

no-default-summary.description: Reports a `<summary>` that starts with the text Visual Studio generates, "Summary description for ...".

no-default-true-switch.description: Reports a `[switch]` parameter with the default value `$true`.

no-default-value-type-constructor.description: Reports `new S()` of a value type that has an implicit parameterless constructor and no initializer: write `default(S)`, or the named constant where there is one (`Guid.Empty`, `CancellationToken.None`, `IntPtr.Zero`, the enum member with value 0).

no-delete-var.description: Reports `delete` applied to a plain variable name, also in parentheses (`delete x`, `delete (x)`).

no-deprecated-attr.description: Reports an attribute that HTML5 no longer has on that element (`align`, `bgcolor`, `border`, ...).

no-deprecated-html-element-is.description: Reports an `is` attribute on a plain HTML element that does not begin with `vue:` (`<tr is="row">`).

no-deprecated-slot-attribute.description: Reports the `slot` attribute on an element that is not a `<slot>`.

no-deprecated-v-on-number-modifiers.description: Reports a key code as a modifier of `v-on` (`@keyup.13`).

no-descending-specificity.description: Reports a rule whose selector ends in the same compound selector (not counting its pseudo-classes) as an earlier rule in the same at-rule, and has a lower specificity.

no-doc-placeholder.description: Reports a `<placeholder>` element in a documentation comment.

no-doc-slashes-in-plain-comment.description: Reports a `///` comment that holds only text and no XML element: a plain comment written with documentation slashes.

no-dupe-class-members.description: Reports a class member whose name is already used by another member of the class: two methods, two fields, a field and a method, two getters.

no-dupe-else-if.description: Reports an `else if` whose condition cannot be true at that point: it repeats a condition of an earlier branch of the chain (`if (a) {} else if (a) {}`), or each operand of its `||` is a whole earlier condition or an operand of an earlier `||` (`if (a || b) {} else if (a) {}`).

no-dupe-keys.description: Reports a name defined twice in `props`, `computed`, `data`, `methods` and `setup` of a component object, and a prop or `defineModel` of `<script setup>` that a top-level name of the script (a `const`, a function, an import) repeats, unless that name reads from the props object (`const a = props.a`, `toRef(props, 'a')`).

no-dupe-on-directives.description: Reports two `on:` directives of one element that have the same event and the same handler (modifiers do not count); both are reported.

no-dupe-style-properties.description: Reports a `style:` directive that repeats the property of an earlier one on the element.

no-dupe-use-directives.description: Reports two `use:` directives of one element that have the same action and the same parameter.

no-dupe-v-else-if.description: Reports a `v-else-if` whose condition is the same as an earlier `v-if` or `v-else-if` of the chain.

no-duplicate-anchors.description: Reports an anchor name that is defined again in the same document, on the second `&name`.

no-duplicate-at-import-rules.description: Reports an `@import` that repeats an earlier one in the same file (same url, same media list; `'a.css'` and `url(a.css)` are the same url).

no-duplicate-case.description: Reports an arm of a `switch`, `match`, `when` or `case` whose test is the same as the test of an earlier arm of the same statement (`case 1:` twice).

no-duplicate-class.description: Reports a class name written twice in one `class` attribute.

no-duplicate-doc-text.description: Reports two elements of one documentation comment with the same text (a `<param>` pasted twice, for example).

no-duplicate-enum-values.description: Reports an enum member initialised with a string or number that an earlier member of the same enum already has (`A = 0, B = 0`).

no-duplicate-heading.description: Reports a heading whose text is the same as an earlier heading in the document, on the later one, with the first as the related location.

no-duplicate-id.description: Reports an `id` that an earlier element of the document already has.

no-duplicate-include.description: Reports an element of a project file (`PackageReference`, `ProjectReference`, `Compile`, ...) that has the same `Include` as an earlier element of the same name in the same parent, on the later one.

no-duplicate-keys.description: Reports a key that a mapping has twice, after decoding escapes and quotes (`{"a": 1, "\u0061": 2}` has `a` twice).

merge_keys.description: Languages with a merge key (YAML `<<`) only. `allow` skips merge keys, which may repeat; `forbid` reports a second one like any other duplicate key.

no-duplicate-pattern.description: Reports a pattern that appears twice with no opposite pattern (`!x` for `x`) between the two, on the second.

no-duplicate-sections.description: Reports a section that has the same name as an earlier section of the file (INI and EditorConfig: the section header, for EditorConfig the glob).

no-duplicate-selectors.description: Reports a selector list that is already used by an earlier rule in the same block or file; the order of the selectors in the list does not matter (`b, a` repeats `a, b`).

no-else-return.description: Reports an `else` when the `if` and every `else if` before it end in `return` (what the `else` itself holds does not matter).

no-emphasis-as-heading.description: Reports a paragraph of one line that is only emphasized text (`**Overview**`) with no closing punctuation, outside a heading.

no-empty-attribute-parens.description: Reports an attribute with empty parentheses: `[Foo()]` is `[Foo]`.

no-empty-block.description: Reports a block with no statement and no comment as the body of an `if`, `else`, loop, `try` or `finally` (`if (a) { }`, `for (;;) { }`).

comment_handles.description: A comment in the block counts as content

ignored_loop_heads.description: A regular expression for the condition or head of a loop whose empty body is left alone

waiting_loops.description: Leave alone an empty loop whose condition is a call

no-empty-catch.description: Reports a `catch`, `except` or `rescue` clause whose body has no statement and no comment (`catch (e) { }`; in Python a lone `pass` counts as no statement).

broad_only.description: Report only a clause that catches everything or a broad type

comment_handles.description: A comment in the body counts as handling the error

no-empty-class-body.description: Reports a class or interface with `{ }` and nothing in it (`class A {}`).

no-empty-comment.description: Reports a comment with no text.

separators.description: Also report an empty line comment between two comments.

no-empty-delegate-parens.description: Reports an anonymous method with an empty parameter list: `delegate() { }` is `delegate { }`.

no-empty-file.description: Reports a `.kt` file with nothing in it but a package, imports and comments.

no-empty-keys.description: Reports a key that is empty or only white space after decoding escapes (`"": 4`).

no-empty-links.description: Reports a link whose destination is empty or only `#` (`[docs]()`, `[docs](#)`).

no-empty-object-type.description: Reports the type `{}` (also in `type T = {}`) and an interface with no members that extends at most one type.

no-empty-pattern.description: Reports a destructuring pattern with nothing in it: `{}` or `[]` in a declaration, a parameter, an assignment target or nested in another pattern (`var {a: {}} = x`).

no-empty-source.description: Reports a file with nothing but whitespace.

no-empty-statement.description: Reports a lone `;` that does nothing.

no-empty-values.description: Reports a mapping key or sequence entry without a value (an implicit null), at the `:` or `-`.

no-eval.description: Reports a call of one of the `calls` that run a string as code, on the call.

calls.description: Calls that run a string as code

no-explicit-any.description: Reports the `any` type wherever a type is written (`let a: any`, `any[]`, a constraint such as `T extends any`).

no-extra-boolean-cast.description: Reports `!!x` and `Boolean(x)` in a place that already converts the value to a boolean: the test of `if`, `while`, `do ... while`, `for` and `?:`, the operand of `!`, and the argument of `Boolean(...)`.

no-extra-non-null-assertion.description: Reports a second non-null assertion in a row (`a!!.b`) and a `!` right before an optional chain (`a!?.b`, `a!?.()`).

no-fallthrough.description: Reports a `case` whose statements can reach the next `case` or `default`, and an empty one that is followed by a blank line, without a comment that says `falls through` before the next one (or at the end of its block).

no-floating-package-version.description: Reports a `PackageReference` or `PackageVersion` whose `Version` contains `*` (`1.*`), on the attribute.

no-flow-mappings.description: Reports a flow mapping (`{a: 1}`), on its opening brace.

no-flow-sequences.description: Reports a flow sequence (`[a, b]`), on its opening bracket.

no-from-platform.description: Reports a `FROM` with a fixed `--platform`, such as `--platform=linux/amd64`.

no-func-assign.description: Reports an assignment to a function that is declared by name (`function f() {} f = 0;`), also `f++`.

no-global-function-names.description: Reports a call of a Sass global function that a module of the standard library replaces (`map-get` is `map.get`, `mix` is `color.mix`); calls written with their module are not reported.

list.description: `name=replacement` entries: a global function and the module function that replaces it.

no-global-vars.description: Reports a variable in the `global:` scope, other than the special variables that PowerShell and its tools use (`$global:LASTEXITCODE`, `$global:ErrorActionPreference`, `$global:PSDefaultParameterValues` and so on).

no-hard-tabs.description: Reports a tab character in a line; a run of tabs is one report.

ignore_kinds.description: Kinds of tokens whose tabs are not reported (for example the code of a fence).

indentation_only.description: Report only the tabs in the whitespace that starts a line.

no-implicit-close.description:
Reports an element whose end tag is left out and that the next sibling or the end tag of its parent closes (`
  • `, `

    `, ...).

no-import-assign.description: Reports a write to an imported name (`import a from 'a'; a = 1`, `bb = 2`), and a write to a member of a namespace import (`ns.x = 1`), a `delete ns.y` and `Object.assign(ns, {})`.

no-inferrable-types.description: Reports a type annotation on a variable, parameter or class property whose initial value already gives that type (`const a: number = 5`, `s: string = 'x'`, `b: boolean = true`, `n: bigint = 1n`).

no-inline-html.description: Reports raw HTML in a document, on each tag of inline HTML and on each HTML block.

no-inline-style.description: Reports a `style` attribute, and a Svelte `style:property` directive.

no-inner-function.description: Reports a `function name() {}` statement in the body of a function, method or closure.

no-invalid-double-slash-comments.description: Reports a rule or declaration that starts with `//`.

no-invalid-position-at-import-rule.description: Reports an `@import` that comes after a rule that is not `@charset`, `@layer` or another `@import`.

no-invalid-position-declaration.description: Reports a declaration at the top of a file, or in an at-rule such as `@media` that is not inside a rule.

no-irregular-whitespace.description: Reports unusual whitespace characters: vertical tab, form feed, no-break space (U+00A0), the spaces and zero-width characters U+2000 to U+200B, line and paragraph separators, narrow no-break space, medium mathematical space, ideographic space, and a byte order mark that is not at the start of the file.

no-latest-tag.description: Reports a `FROM` whose image has the tag `latest` (`alpine:latest`).

no-lone-template.description: Reports a nested `<template>` that has no directive (`v-if`, `v-for`, `v-slot`, ...).

no-lonely-if.description: Reports an `if` that is the only statement of an `else` block (`else { if (b) { ... } }`), also when that `if` has its own `else`.

no-loss-of-precision.description: Reports a number literal that the 64-bit double it becomes does not hold exactly: `9007199254740993` (above 2^53), `0x20000000000001`, a value that is too large (`1e400`, becomes `Infinity`) or too small (`2e-400`, becomes `0`).

no-misleading-backtick.description: Reports a backtick that is followed by blanks before the end of the line.

no-misleading-character-class.description: Reports a character class in the constant string given to `new Regex(...)` and the static methods of `Regex`, in which a combining mark follows another character.

no-missing-references.description: Reports an attribute that refers to an `id` (`for`, `aria-labelledby`, `list`, `headers`, `form`, ...) when no element of the document has that id.

no-missing-space-atx.description: Reports a paragraph that starts with one to six `#` and no space after them (`#Heading`).

no-misused-new.description: Reports `new` and `constructor` declarations that do not describe a constructor: a class method signature `new(): C;` without a body that returns the class itself, an interface signature `new (): I` that returns the interface itself, and an interface member named `constructor()`.

no-multiple-main.description: Reports a second `<main>` element that is not `hidden`.

no-name-underscore.description: Reports a name that starts or ends with an underscore: a type, field, argument, enum value, directive, operation, fragment or alias, and every reference to one.

no-namespace.description: Reports a `namespace N {}` or `module N {}` declaration, also a dotted `namespace A.B {}`.

no-negated-async.description: Reports `!(x | async)` and `(x | async) === false` in an Angular template.

no-nested-onbuild.description: Reports an `ONBUILD` whose instruction is `ONBUILD`, `FROM` or `MAINTAINER`.

no-nested-style-tag.description: Reports a `<style>` that is inside an element.

no-non-null-asserted-optional-chain.description: Reports a non-null assertion on the end of an optional chain: `a?.b!` and `(a?.b)!`.

no-non-null-assertion.description: Reports a non-null assertion (`a!`, `a!.b`) in a TypeScript file.

no-object-in-text-mustaches.description: Reports an object, an array, a function or a class written in `{ }` among text.

no-octal.description: Reports a number literal that starts with `0` followed by another digit, such as `017` or `08`.

no-octal-values.description: Reports a plain `0755` (octal to YAML 1.1 parsers, decimal 755 to YAML 1.2) or `0o755` (octal to YAML 1.2, a string to YAML 1.1).

no-plain-text-password.description: Reports a `[string]` parameter whose name contains `password`, `passphrase` or `cred`.

no-print.description: Reports a call of one of the `calls` that write to the console, unless an argument matching `redirect` sends the output elsewhere and none matching `console` sends it back to the console.

console.description: An argument that sends the output to the console

redirect.description: An argument that sends the output elsewhere

no-prototype-builtins.description: Reports a call of `hasOwnProperty`, `isPrototypeOf` or `propertyIsEnumerable` made on an object itself: `obj.hasOwnProperty(k)`, `obj?.hasOwnProperty(k)` and `obj['hasOwnProperty'](k)`.

no-raw-special-elements.description: Reports `<head>`, `<body>`, `<window>`, `<document>`, `<element>` and `<options>`, which are plain elements in Svelte.

no-recursive-alias.description: Reports an alias that is inside the node of its own anchor, which makes the data refer to itself.

no-redundant-for.description: Reports a `<label>` whose `for` names a control that is inside the label.

no-redundant-role.description: Reports a `role` on an element that already has that role by its name (`<nav role="navigation">`, `<button role="button">`, `<ul role="list">`).

no-redundant-target-platform.description: Reports a `FROM` with `--platform=$TARGETPLATFORM` (or `${TARGETPLATFORM}`), which is what `FROM` does without the option.

no-regex-spaces.description: Reports two or more spaces outside a character class in the constant string given to `new Regex(...)` and the static methods of `Regex`.

no-region-in-body.description: Reports a `#region` inside a block (a method, accessor or lambda body, or any block in one).

no-regions.description: Reports every `#region` outside a block (a region inside a block is `no-region-in-body`'s), also in disabled `#if` branches.

no-require-imports.description: Reports a call of the global `require(...)` and an `import x = require(...)`.

no-reserved-stage-name.description: Reports a stage named `scratch` or `context` (`FROM alpine AS scratch`), compared without regard to case.

no-returns-on-void.description: Reports a `<returns>` on a method or delegate that returns `void`.

no-reversed-links.description: Reports link syntax written the wrong way round (`(text)[url]`), at the start of a paragraph or after whitespace, on the whole paragraph.

no-secret-in-env.description: Reports an `ARG` or `ENV` whose name suggests a secret.

no-self-assign.description: Reports an assignment whose two sides are the same tokens (`x = x`, `x.y = x.y`, `x[0] = x[0]`, `x ||= x`).

operators.description: The assignment operators that store the right side as it is

no-self-closing.description: Reports an element that is self-closed with `/>` and is not a void element (`<div />`).

no-self-compare.description: Reports an equality or comparison whose two sides are the same tokens (`x === x`, `x < x`).

no-shadow-restricted-names.description: Reports a variable, function, class, parameter or function-expression name that is `NaN`, `Infinity`, `eval`, `arguments` or `undefined`.

no-single-line-block-comment.description: Reports a block comment that fits on one line and ends its line (`/* text */`): it is written as a line comment.

no-space-in-code.description: Reports a code span that starts or ends with a space (`` ` code ` ``).

no-space-in-links.description: Reports link text that starts or ends with a space (`[ docs ](url)`).

no-sparse-arrays.description: Reports a hole in an array literal, at the extra comma: `[1, , 2]` and `[, 1]`.

no-target-blank.description: Reports a link to another site with `target="_blank"` that does not have both `noopener` and `noreferrer` in its `rel`.

no-this-alias.description: Reports `const self = this`, `let self = this` and `self = this`: a variable that holds `this`.

no-throw-generic.description: Reports a `raise` or `throw` of one of the generic `types`, itself or a call of it.

no-trailing-punctuation.description: Reports a heading that ends with `.`, `,`, `;`, `:` or `!` (or the full-width forms).

no-trailing-whitespace.description: Reports spaces or tabs at the end of a line, from the first one to the line break.
